subject: The main window's area containers (Tracks, Control Bar, Inspector, Library, Mixer): which row of Logic.framework's Localizable.strings each one's description equals
question: On a zh-TW Logic, which of each area's candidate rows -- `<area>#acc`, the plain key, `StrTabBtnLabel|||<area>`, `StrViewBtns|||<area>` -- does the area container's AXDescription equal exactly?

reverify.expected: exits 0 on a zh-TW Logic; the AXGroup verdicts carry StrTabBtnLabel and StrViewBtns as consistent, and the descriptions quoted in observations recur
reverify.cost: ~1 min; needs Logic relaunched in zh-TW (`defaults write com.apple.logic10 AppleLanguages -array zh-Hant`) on a project whose main window shows Tracks, the Control Bar, the Inspector, the Library and the docked Mixer. Nothing is pressed or written

canon.used_for: the #acc candidate for the Control Bar area's description; it equals the reading exactly
the StrTabBtnLabel candidate for the Control Bar area's description; it equals the reading exactly
the #acc candidate for the Inspector area's description; it equals the reading exactly
the plain candidate for the Inspector area's description; it equals the reading exactly
the StrViewBtns candidate for the Inspector area's description; it equals the reading exactly
the #acc candidate for the Library area's description; it equals the reading exactly
the plain candidate for the Library area's description; it equals the reading exactly
the StrTabBtnLabel candidate for the Library area's description; it equals the reading exactly
the StrViewBtns candidate for the Library area's description; it equals the reading exactly
the plain candidate for the Tracks area's description; it equals the reading exactly
the StrTabBtnLabel candidate for the Tracks area's description; it equals the reading exactly
the #acc candidate for the Mixer area's description; it equals the reading exactly

method: Logic relaunched after `defaults write com.apple.logic10 AppleLanguages -array zh-Hant` on a disposable project with the Library, Inspector and Mixer shown, then read by Scripts/livekit/live_979_area_description_rows.py, added in this change. Its probe, Scripts/livekit/ax_979_area_rows_probe.swift, reads role, AXDescription, AXTitle and AXIdentifier of every element within two levels of each window and keeps the raw AXError of any failed read. The candidate rows are read from the installed Logic.framework's own Localizable.strings for this locale at run time, not from this repository's pinned index. A description is credited to an area when it equals one of that area's candidates ignoring case, and is then compared with each candidate exactly; every other key carrying the same string is listed in the evidence. All ten locales were read in one sequence on the same project, one relaunch each, and Logic was returned to Korean afterwards. Nothing was pressed or written.

observations.what: each key shape judged against every AXGroup reading of an area it has a row for, compared exactly

conclusion: On a zh-TW Logic each area container's description equals its StrTabBtnLabel row where it has one (Tracks, Control Bar, Library, Mixer) and StrViewBtns|||Inspector for the Inspector; the Mixer's strip container carries the same string as its group. Every shape agrees with every reading here, so this locale separates none of them.
limits: One host: Logic 12.3 (6674) on macOS 26.3 (25D125), one project. Other builds are not measured here.
A string equality, not a code path: the harness does not observe which key Logic looks up. A build that rendered the same string from another key would read the same.

For the Mixer, the StrTabBtnLabel, StrViewBtns and plain rows carry the same value in all ten locales, so no Mixer reading chooses among them. The choice rests on the other areas: the plain-key shape is refuted by the German Library and the #acc shape by the Portuguese Control Bar, while StrTabBtnLabel holds wherever it has a row.
Only elements within two levels of a window were read. The Library's AXBrowser, which libraryPanelLabel matches, sits deeper and is not covered; neither are track-header buttons or menus.
The Control Bar's view buttons (AXCheckBox) carry the same names and are judged separately in the evidence; no label set in this change addresses them.
No product path was driven here. Matching ignores case, and #977's records drove the Mixer and plug-in paths in all ten locales on the same build.
